verdict.rationale: Entrust's own Workflow Studio provides a no-code, flow-chart-style builder for verification workflows. Webhooks emit events when workflow status changes. However, the evidence never shows user-defined conditional rules or event-triggered actions inside the product; the webhooks only notify external systems. Missing for 10: documented rule/condition logic, event-based triggers that launch actions automatically, examples of the rules engine, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Build workflows visually using our no-code Workflow Builder tool, in a format similar to flow charts or process diagrams.
It's a no-code, drag and drop interface that allows you to build, maintain and update workflows seamlessly without the need for developer involvement.
configuring webhook events to notify you of changes in workflow status
